name: spin-wheel
title: Spin Wheel
description: A casino-grade "spin & win" wheel for coupons and rewards: glossy wedges in a gold rim of chasing lights, a 3D SPIN hub, and a flapper that ticks over every divider with haptics. Tap, flick or spin it from code — it keeps turning while your server picks the prize, then eases onto it and lights up the win.
